title: The Graham–Pollak theorem
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the Graham–Pollak theorem: the edge set of the complete graph K_n cannot be partitioned into fewer than n − 1 complete bipartite graphs, together with the matching construction by n − 1 stars. Biclique decompositions are encoded by families of pairs of disjoint vertex sets covering every pair of distinct vertices exactly once. Mathlib does not contain this theorem.
